name: Diamond Apparel Manufacturing
old_description: Contract screen printing and embroidery with outstanding quality, speed, and transparency.
about:
Based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey, Diamond Apparel Manufacturing operates as a contract screen printing and embroidery provider. The company serves clients ranging from Fortune 500 corporations to emerging apparel brands, offering decoration services on orders from a few hundred to 10,000 pieces.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, and private-label services supported by in-house graphic artists who deliver design proofs within 24 hours. Daily production turnaround times are posted on a client portal, and an online pricing tool allows quick quotes. The facility also builds integrated online stores in five to seven business days, handles product sourcing, and ships via UPS, FedEx, USPS, and LTL with blind-shipment options. Free inbound freight is offered to contract customers.

Customers include large enterprises, promotional distributors, multi-location franchises, and schools. The company emphasizes transparency, dedicated account representatives, and technology investments to meet tight deadlines.

Diamond Apparel Manufacturing was founded to deliver a competitive, transparent contract decoration relationship that helps clients grow their business and retain customers through quality, speed, and end-to-end visibility.
